hero.subtitle: SmartLink connects drivers, station teams, fleet operators, and network partners to the same live picture of supply, queues, payments, and forecourt movement.
hero.metric1Label: Live availability, fuel type, and service readiness in one operating view
hero.metric2Label: Drivers see demand before joining a forecourt line
hero.metric3Label: Wallet, prepay, reservation, and reconciliation flows ready for rollout
hero.panelSub: A sharper operating layer for live supply, queues, service windows, payments, and station reporting.
hero.summary1Body: Live stock and service status from active station feeds
hero.summary2Body: Wait pressure surfaced before drivers arrive
hero.tileOpsBody: Dashboards, telemetry, and cleaner forecourt coordination.

mapPreview.title: Route decisions based on live station conditions, not rumours.
mapPreview.subtitle: Drivers compare nearby stations, confirm fuel type, check wait pressure, and choose the most reliable stop before leaving the road.
mapPreview.bullet1: Check nearby stations and expected queue pressure
mapPreview.bullet3: Receive alerts as your service window moves
mapPreview.insight1: Cuts wasted trips when stock changes unexpectedly
mapPreview.insight2: Reduces forecourt crowding by spreading demand earlier
mapPreview.insight3: Gives drivers a clearer service expectation

how.title: Move from discovery to service in three controlled steps.
how.subtitle: The same flow keeps drivers informed while giving stations cleaner demand signals.
how.step1Body: See availability, queue direction, and distance in one disciplined shortlist.
how.step2Title: Join a queue or reserve a service window
how.step2Body: Pick the best station, prepay when needed, and avoid uncertainty before departure.
how.step3Body: Receive alerts, cleaner reconciliation, and a calmer handoff at the forecourt.

features.title: A practical control layer for fuel movement
features.subtitle: SmartLink is built around the real decisions people make at stations: where to go, what is available, how long the queue is, and how the transaction is reconciled.
features.availabilityBody: Show fuel availability, service status, and station confidence before drivers commit to a stop.
features.queueBody: Expose wait pressure, route demand across nearby stations, and open controlled reservation windows when needed.
features.reservationBody: Support payment-ready flows that reduce counter friction and improve settlement visibility.
features.verifiedBody: Give attendants and managers one place to update pumps, queues, deliveries, and service readiness.
features.alertsBody: Turn operational events into exports, alerts, reconciliation, and MERA-ready reporting workflows.
features.transparencyBody: Give drivers and partners cleaner information about supply, wait time, fulfilment, and station accountability.

stations.title: One operating layer for drivers, station teams, fleets, and network partners.
stations.subtitle: SmartLink presents a simple journey to drivers while giving operators a denser control surface behind the scenes.
stations.description: Use SmartLink to reduce forecourt congestion, improve station communication, support digital payments, and expose cleaner operational data across the network.
stations.driversBody: Find supply faster, compare queues, reserve eligible slots, and pay with more confidence.
stations.stationsBody: Manage demand, update service readiness, and keep the forecourt moving with less friction.
stations.enterpriseBody: Support fleet workflows, regulatory visibility, and multi-site coordination through one platform layer.
stations.enterprisePoint3: Consistent data for partners and regulators
stations.devTitle: Integrations that fit station infrastructure, not brochure software.
stations.devBody: Connect queue events, wallet workflows, telemetry, delivery signals, reporting, and monitoring into existing station or fleet systems.

trust.title: Designed for calmer queues, clearer station communication, and accountable service.
trust.item1Label: Availability and queue changes surfaced as they happen
trust.item2Label: Reservations, prepay flows, and operator actions leave an audit trail
trust.item3Label: Partner dashboards support reconciliation, reporting, and live updates
trust.item4Label: Fleet, regulator, and integration workflows fit the same operating layer

finalCta.title: Make every fuel stop easier to plan and easier to operate.
finalCta.subtitle: Open the live map, onboard a station, or prepare your operations team for queue visibility, wallet-ready payments, and station reporting.
finalCta.note: SmartLink is designed for Malawi fuel users, station teams, and infrastructure partners.

footer.tagline: Fuel discovery, queue coordination, reservations, and station operations in one service layer.
